hooks.command: if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Skipping C# formatting: jq not installed.' >&2; exit 0; fi; if ! command -v dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Skipping C# formatting: dotnet SDK not installed.' >&2; exit 0; fi; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); case "$f" in *.cs) dotnet format Augustus/Augustus.sln --include "$f" --no-restore ;; esac
